modules.module_title: Prepare brine solution(preserves) and cure vegetables

pcs.pc_description: assemble the ingredients required for pickle making such as vinegar, salt, sugar, etc.
measure ingredients (salt, water, and any additional ingredients (e.g., sugar, spices) ) according to the recipe.
prepare the brine solution for softening the vegetables
use salinometer to check the salt concentration of the brine solution
• Maintain appropriate storage conditions (temperature, humidity) to preserve the • brine’s quality.
transfer the brine solution from mixing tank to storage tanks while ensuring no spillage takes place
Store the prepared brine solution in clean, labeled containers.
fill the steam-jacketed kettle with water adequately for steaming the vegetables/fruits
Apply any necessary pre-treatments like blanching or soaking to prepare the produce for curing.
place the cut vegetables in brine solution for fermentation
stir the vegetables periodically for salt equilibrium and check the acidity to confirm that the fermentation process is complete
check the curing progress for any signs of spoilage or contamination.
Blanch vegetables to preserve color, flavor, and texture
crush the cured vegetables with a mill/crusher and make a coarse paste with a pulper
transfer the coarse paste from pulper to grinding machine to make a fine paste
Cook the paste to develop flavors and reduce microbial load.
add preservatives, salts, etc. as per type of paste to be produced
Allow the paste to cool down using methods like- Air Cooling, Blast Chilling, Ice Bath Cooling, Water Jacket Cooling, Cold Room Storage.
transfer the fermented vegetables to the pickle mixing machine appropriately
prepare spice mix as per formulation; add measured quantity and oil to the vegetables
mix all the ingredients, stir well and check for the consistency
transfer pickle into designated container (for pickle in oil) once it is mixed well
control speed of the conveyor to load the pickle mixture into the hopper of the filling machine
position the measured containers right under the filling nozzle
inspect the finished product to confirm whether it meets the quality standards of the organisation
add water in the batch mixing cooker, and put the cut fruits or vegetables and bring it to a boil till the ingredients become tender and transparent
prepare the sugar syrup based on the type of murabba to be produced
use refractometer to measure the degree brix (sugar content) of the syrup
add boiled fruits/vegetables to the sugar syrup and heat them until they are evenly mixed
cool the mixture prepared and transfer it to the storage tank for packaging
Select appropriate packaging materials considering the type of product and packaging requirements.
Ensure packaging materials meet regulatory standards and quality specifications.
Verify the integrity of packaging materials to prevent contamination or damage to the product.
load appropriate labels in the packaging machine and accurate information for packing the finished product while following food laws and regulations
• Operate packaging machinery effectively and safely, including bottle fillers, capping • machines, sealing equipment, and pouch filling machines.
monitor the packaging process (such as pickle filling, sealing, labelling, etc.) and carry out adjustments as required
• handover a sample of the finished product to concerned personnel for quality analysis • as per production requirements Analysis – physical, chemical, biological, sensory, shelf life etc.
pack the finished product into cart
report discrepancies/concerns to supervisor promptly for immediate action
attend minor repairs/faults of all machines (if any)
clean work area, machineries, equipment and tools using industry approved cleaning procedures (such as Clean in Place, Cleaning out of Place), cleaning agents and sanitizers
